cause: PostgreSQL to_jsonb(timestamptz) renders the session timezone; same absolute time gives different profile JSON and hash.
fix: Recover the consistent offset from all original profile JSON values and bind only replay connection TimeZone. Preserve all original timestamps, hashes and stored data. Reject mixed offsets.
real_regression_cases: same SQL values viewed in UTC fail original profile hash
recovery in recorded offset exactly reproduces original snapshot and hash
